blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Transformer-based view synthesis models render each target viewpoint from the source images, without an explicit 3D representation, which lets them reproduce fine detail and view-dependent effects. However, their decoder attends to every source token for every frame, so rendering slows with each source image. Rasterization avoids this by culling primitives that the viewpoint does not see, but source tokens cannot be culled this way, as they have no explicit position or extent. Our key insight is that source tokens are nonetheless spatial anchors: each encodes a local region of the scene, so the decoder's attention for any viewpoint concentrates on a few of them. A lightweight router predicts these tokens from the source tokens and the viewpoint, and the decoder attends only to a fixed budget of top-ranked tokens, so its cost no longer depends on the number of source tokens. We supervise the router with the decoder's attention, using non-maximum suppression to demote redundant tokens. With 24 source images and two views' worth of tokens, our model renders 6.4 times faster than LagerNVS, at a PSNR only 0.68 dB lower. One ranking serves every budget, so the budget can change at render time.
blocks.zh: 基于变形器的视图合成模型将每个目标视角从源图像中渲染出来,没有明确的3D表示,这使得它们可以复制精细的细节和依赖视图的效果. 然而,他们的解码器处理每个帧的每个源符号,因此渲染速度与每个源图像缓慢. rasterization通过挤压观点所看不到的原始人来避免这种情况,但源符号不能这样挤压,因为它们没有明确的位置或范围. 我们的关键洞察力是,源符号仍然是空间锚:每个符号都编码了场景的局部区域,所以任何观点的解码器注意力都集中在其中的几个. 轻量级路由器从源代码和视角来预测这些令牌,解码器只参加排名最高的令牌的固定预算,因此其成本不再取决于源令牌的数量. 我们用解码器的注意力监督路由器,使用非最大压制来降级多余的代币. 有了24个源图像和两个视图的值值,我们的模型使6.4倍于LagerNVS,在PSNR中只降低0.68 dB. 每个预算都有一个排名,因此预算可以随时变化。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Classical rendering pipelines owe much of their speed to explicit primitives, which can be culled for a viewpoint down to the small fraction that contributes to it.
Because each primitive occupies a known region of space, a renderer can discard those that lie outside the view frustum or behind other surfaces without rasterizing them [ 13 , 19 , 14 ] .
As a result, the cost of rendering a viewpoint depends on what is visible from it, not on the extent of the scene or on how many images it was reconstructed from.
blocks.zh:
古典的渲染管道 大部分的速度都归功于显性原始的, 而显性原始的透视可以被挤压到微小的微小部分。
由于每个原始人占据一个已知的空间区域,一个渲染器可以丢弃那些位于视野外或其他表面后方的,而不对它们进行光圈化[13,19,14].
因此,渲染观点的成本取决于从中可见的事物,而不是场景的广度或从中重建出多少图像.

blocks.en: Transformer-based view synthesis models [ 50 , 30 , 56 ] synthesize some of the most accurate novel views from a few images [ 30 , 56 ] : an encoder turns the source images once into source tokens, one per image patch, and a decoder renders each patch of the target image by attending to them.
blocks.zh: 基于变形器的视图合成模型[50,30,56]从少数图像中合成了一些最准确的新观点[30,56]: 一个编码器将源图像一次转换成源符,每个图像补丁一个,一个解码器通过关注它们使目标图像的每个补丁都产生.

blocks.en:
Two properties of this design make rendering slow.
First, every source image adds a whole set of tokens, and the decoder attends to all of them for every viewpoint, so its cost grows with the number of source images.
Second, view synthesis relies on redundancy: a part of the scene must be seen in several source images to estimate its depth and view-dependent appearance, so the same part is encoded by tokens from several images.
blocks.zh:
这个设计的两个属性使得渲染速度缓慢.
首先,每个源图像都增加了一套完整的符号,解码器为每个视角都参加,因此其成本随源图像的数量而增加.
其次,视图合成依赖于冗余:在多个源图像中必须看到一部分场景来估计其深度和视线依赖的外观,因此同一部分由多个图像的符号编码.

blocks.en:
Our key insight is that source tokens are locality-preserving anchors in the scene, and hence amenable to optimizations analogous to those of rasterization.
Unlike explicit primitives, however, they have no position or extent to test against the view frustum or other surfaces, so they cannot be culled directly.
The decoder’s attention [ 56 ] instead identifies the tokens that a viewpoint needs, concentrating on a small fraction of them.
However, this attention is only available after running the decoder on all source tokens, which is the cost we aim to avoid.
We therefore train a router that predicts, from the source tokens and the viewpoint alone, which tokens the decoder attends to, and let the decoder attend only to the top-ranked ones within a fixed budget.
The router splits its work in two: a heavy branch processes the source tokens once per scene, like the encoder, and a light branch scores them for every viewpoint, adding little to the rendering time.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要见解是,源头标志是现场的局部保护锚,因此,可以进行类似于光栅化的优化。
然而与显性原始人不同的是,它们没有位置或范围来测试对视图的frustum或其他表面,因此它们不能直接被挤压.
解码器的注意[56] 却指明了观点需要的标志,集中于其中的一小部分。
然而,只有在所有源代码符上运行解码器后,才能得到这种关注,而这正是我们力求避免的成本.
因此,我们训练一个路由器,它从源代码和观点上单独预测解码器所注意的路由器,并且让解码器在固定预算范围内只处理排名最高的路由器.
路由器将其工作分成两部分:一个沉重的分支处理每个场景一次的源令牌,就像编码器一样,一个轻分支对每个视角都进行评分,很少给渲染时间增加.

blocks.en:
Ranking by attention mass alone does not address the second problem, since the tokens that encode the most salient regions of the viewpoint in different source images all receive high mass.
A similar problem arises in edge, keypoint and object detection, where detectors respond at many nearby locations around the same structure, and non-maximum suppression resolves it by keeping only the strongest response [ 7 , 3 ] .
Source tokens from different views share no image coordinates, so we measure their overlap by their cross-attention profiles.
We discount each token’s attention mass by its overlap with the tokens already selected and supervise the router with the resulting ranking, so that no suppression step runs when rendering.
blocks.zh:
仅按注意力质量排序并不能解决第二个问题,因为在不同源图像中将观点最显著区域编码的标志都得到高质量。
在边缘,键点和物体探测中也会出现类似的问题,探测器在同一结构周围的许多附近地点响应,非最大压制通过只保留最强响应[7,3]来解决.
来自不同观点的源代码没有图像坐标,所以我们通过它们的交叉注意配置来测量它们的重叠.
我们忽略了每个信物的注意力质量,因为它与已经选择的信物重叠,并监督路由器的排名,这样在渲染时就不会出现压制步骤。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • a router that ranks the source tokens for every viewpoint and processes them once per scene, so that the decoder attends only to a fixed budget of tokens and its cost barely depends on the number of source images; • router supervision by non-maximum suppression over the source tokens’ cross-attention profiles, which gives one score per token for every budget; • experiments showing that, with a token budget of two views’ worth and 24 source images, our model renders 6.4 times as fast as LagerNVS [ 56 ] at a PSNR 0.68 dB lower, that selecting tokens outperforms selecting whole source views in quality and stability along a camera path, and that non-maximum suppression matters most with many views.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 一个路由器,将每种观点的源符号排序,每场处理一次,这样,解码器只能使用固定的路由器预算,其成本几乎不取决于源图像的数量; 由非最大程度的压制对源符号的交叉意向剖面进行路由器监督,使每个预算每个信使得一分; 实验显示,用两种观点的价值和24个源图像的符号预算,我们的模型在PSNR 0.68 dB 下,使6.4倍于LagerNVS [56], 选择信号比按照相机路径在质量和稳定性上选择全部源视图要好,而且非最大程度的压制在很多观点中最为重要。

blocks.en: Because a single ranking serves every budget, the budget can change from one viewpoint to the next without re-encoding the scene.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Feed-forward methods have predicted multiplane images [ 82 ] , neural radiance fields conditioned on source-view features [ 72 , 9 , 59 ] and, more recently, 3D Gaussians [ 32 ] for fast rasterization [ 8 , 11 , 74 , 66 , 12 , 70 , 29 , 71 , 61 , 5 ] , whose explicit representation is hard to predict for thin structures, reflections and unobserved regions [ 56 ] .
Transformer-based view synthesis models [ 50 , 30 , 28 , 77 , 33 , 27 , 56 ] instead run a large decoder for every frame and are the state of the art from a few source views [ 56 ] ; our router seeks a middle ground that keeps this renderer and its quality but, like a rasterizer, uses only the tokens each viewpoint needs.
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward方法预测了多行星影像[82],神经辐射场以源视特征为条件[72,9,59],最近, 3D Gaussians [32] 用于快速光栅化 [8, 11, 74, 66, 12, 70, 29, 71, 61, 5], 其清晰的表述很难预测薄的结构,反射和未观测区域 [56].
基于变形器的视图合成模型 [50, 30, 28, 77, 33, 27, 56] 转而为每帧运行一个大解码器,并且是少数来源视图的艺术状态 [56]; 我们的路由器寻求一个中场,保持这种渲染器及其质量,但像光栅一样,只使用每个视角所需要的符号.

blocks.en:
Bottleneck architectures [ 30 , 33 , 44 ] and compressed representations [ 62 ] condense the scene into fewer tokens once per scene, and CLiFT [ 62 ] also gathers tokens by ray proximity to the target.
In two works concurrent with ours, GLoD-LVSM [ 40 ] culls condensed tokens outside the target frustum, and TTB [ 39 ] bakes the cross-view attention into a small network.
Token pruning and merging in vision transformers [ 4 , 45 , 38 ] and across views [ 52 , 80 , 6 ] act once per input, so here they would keep the same tokens for every target viewpoint.
Visual token pruning in multimodal language models selects image tokens for a query, the analogue of our target viewpoint [ 10 , 78 , 55 , 1 , 63 , 16 , 75 ] , and methods that remove redundant tokens find them by comparing features.
Overlapping source views, however, can encode the same surface with dissimilar tokens, so we compare their contributions to the target image.
Sparse DETR [ 49 ] trains a token scorer from its decoder’s attention but selects once for all object queries, and sparse attention and KV-cache eviction in language models [ 79 , 57 , 68 ] , including selectors distilled from attention [ 18 , 15 ] , score keys with the model’s own queries, which for a target viewpoint would require running the decoder.
Our router instead selects tokens per target viewpoint, from the viewpoint alone, for all of its target tokens and decoder blocks.
blocks.zh:
Bottleneck architectures [30,33,44] 和压缩的表示式 [62] 将场景压缩为每场场景一次更少的代币,CLIFT [62] 也通过射线接近目标来收集代币.
在与我们同时进行的两部作品中,GLOD-LVSM [40] culls在目标frustum之外凝聚着符号, TTB [39] 将交叉视点烤成一个小网络.
在视觉变压器[4,45,38]和横跨视界[52,80,6]中盘旋和合并,每输入一次,因此它们会保留每个目标视角的相同符号.
在多模式语言模型中浏览可视化符号会选择用于查询的图像符号,我们目标视角的模拟[10,78,55,1,63,16,75],以及删除冗余符号的方法通过比较特性来发现它们.
然而,重叠的源视图可以将相同的表面编码成不同的符号,因此我们比较它们对于目标图像的贡献.
Sparse DETR [49] 从它的解码器的注意力中训练一个符号计分器,但为所有对象查询选择一次,在语言模型中很少注意和KV-cache驱逐[79,57,68],包括从注意力中提炼出来的选择器[18,15],用模型自己的查询来计分键,对于目标视角来说,需要运行解码器.
我们的路由器只从每个目标角度选择其所有目标标志和解码块的符号。

blocks.en:
Neural image-based rendering keeps the nearest source views [ 59 , 53 , 42 ] ( Sec. 4.4 ) or those overlapping the target viewpoint most under a proxy geometry [ 47 ] , and Farchione et al. [ 17 ] learn to choose frames covering a set of target viewpoints.
Camera-controlled video generators retrieve earlier frames overlapping the target viewpoint by field of view [ 65 , 73 ] or visible surfels [ 36 ] , or route attention to memory tokens on the same surfaces [ 69 ] .
Classical methods select per scene cell or pixel by a geometric cost of depth, viewing angle and distance [ 21 , 22 ] , like pixelwise view selection in multi-view stereo [ 51 ] ; all of these need poses or proxy geometry, the per-pixel ones give every part of the target image the same number of contributions, and whole-view selection flickers when the selection changes [ 48 ] .
Our router selects individual tokens without explicit geometry and learns from the decoder where to spend its budget.
blocks.zh:
基于神经图像的渲染保留了最近的源视图[59,53,42](sec.4.4),或者在代几何学[47]下最重叠的目标视角,以及Farchione等人. [17] 学会选择涵盖一组目标视角的帧.
相机控制的视频生成器通过视场[65,73]或可见的冲浪器[36],或同一表面对内存符号的路由注意[69],检索早期的帧与目标视角重叠.
经典方法通过深度,视角和距离的几何成本来选择每个场景单元格或像素[21,22],如多视图立体声中像素视图选择[51];所有这些需要都呈现或代理几何,每像素需要给目标图像的每一部分投影次数相同,在选择改变时全景选择闪烁器. [48].
我们的路由器在不明确几何的情况下选择单个的符号,并从解码器中学习如何花费预算.

As measured in the top plot of Fig. 2 , the cost of processing the source tokens ( c ​ N cN , orange) dominates the time to render a viewpoint and grows with the number of source views: it adds 3.2 ms with every source view on average and takes 94% of the 79 ms needed with 24 source views, whereas F F stays near 4 ms.
We therefore aim to shrink this cost and keep it fixed regardless of the number of source views.
The simplest way is to process only a fixed budget of B ≪ N B\ll N source tokens for every viewpoint.
For a chosen budget B B , rendering a viewpoint then costs F + c ​ B F+cB for any number of source views, much as culling lets a classical renderer rasterize only the primitives that a viewpoint sees.
A complementary direction is to lower c c , the cost per source token: a decoder that does not update the source tokens can cache their keys and values once per scene [ 27 , 54 ] , but the cost of the source tokens then still grows with N N .
Compressing the source tokens once per scene, as the encoder-decoder variant of LVSM [ 30 ] does, fixes their number regardless of the size of the scene, which costs accuracy [ 56 ] .
Classical rendering pipelines instead keep the full representation of a scene and render quickly by discarding what a viewpoint does not see, so we likewise keep all source tokens and select B B of them for every viewpoint.
blocks.zh:
如图2的上图所示,处理源令牌(c N cN, 橙色)的成本支配着提出观点的时间,并随着源视图数量的增长而增加:平均每个源视图都增加了3.2 ms,需要79 ms的94%,有24个源视图,而F F则停留在4 ms附近.
因此,我们的目标是缩小这一成本,使之固定,而不论来源意见有多少。
最简单的方式是只处理B QQ N B\ll N源代码的固定预算,用于每个视图。
对于一个选定的预算B B , 提出一个观点之后, F + c B F + c B 对于任何数量的源视图都要花费 , 就像 culling 让一个古典的渲染器 让一个观点所看到的原始人光滑。
一个互补的方向是降低cc,每个源令牌的成本:一个不更新源令牌的解码器每场景[27,54]一次可以缓存它们的密钥和值,但源令牌的成本随后随着N N的不断增长.
如LVSM [30] 的编码器-解码器变体一样,每场一次压缩源令牌,不论场面大小,都固定其编号,这需要准确性[56].

blocks.en:
Our key hypothesis is that, for a given viewpoint, the decoder’s attention concentrates on a small fraction of the source tokens ( Fig. 3 ).
The attention of a target patch falls on a few source tokens that show the same part of the scene in each source view ( Fig. 3 a), so that each source token acts as a local anchor in the scene.
This holds for every target token of the viewpoint ( Fig. 3 b), and over the 140 test scenes of DL3DV [ 41 ] , two views’ worth of source tokens receive 85% of the decoder’s attention with 24 source views, while these tokens change from one viewpoint to the next.
This concentration relies on locality: if each source token encoded the whole scene, every token would contribute to every viewpoint, and no fixed budget would suffice.
We therefore give the decoder the source tokens that it attends to most, and with two views’ worth of tokens, our model renders within 0.68 dB of LagerNVS [ 56 ] with all the tokens of 24 source views ( Sec. 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们的关键假设是,对于特定的观点来说,解码器的注意力集中在一小部分源符号(图3)上.
目标补丁的注意力落在几个源代码上,显示每个源代码视图(图3 a)中场景的相同部分,因此每个源代码都作为场景中的本地锚.
这为观点的每个目标标志(图3b)和DL3DV[41]的140个测试场景提供了支撑,两种观点的源标志得到85%的解码器关注,有24个源标志,而这些标志则从一个角度转移到另一个角度。
这种集中取决于地点:如果每个源符号编码整个场景,每个符号都有助于每一种观点,而没有固定的预算就足够了。
因此,我们给解码器提供它所处理的多数来源的标志,用两种观点值的标志,我们的模型在LagerNVS的0.68 dB [56] 以24个来源的标志(第4.2条)。

blocks.en:
The decoder’s attention, however, is only available after running the decoder on all source tokens, which is the cost we aim to avoid.
We therefore train a router that predicts this attention from the source tokens and the viewpoint before the decoder runs ( Sec. 3.1 and Fig. 4 ), and adapt the pretrained decoder to the sparse subsets of tokens that the router selects ( Sec. 3.3 ).
The part of the router that runs for every viewpoint must take little time next to the decoder, or routing would defeat its purpose: most of the router runs once per scene, and the rest takes under 1 ms of the 12 ms per frame (bottom plot of Fig. 2 ).
View synthesis also relies on redundancy, since each part of the scene must be seen in several source views for its depth and appearance to be estimated.
The source tokens that encode the same part of the scene in these views all receive high attention, so that ranking by attention alone spends the budget on the same parts of the scene several times ( Fig. 5 ), which we resolve with non-maximum suppression ( Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
然而,解码器的注意力只有在运行所有源符号的解码器之后才能得到,而这正是我们所要避免的代价。
因此,我们训练一个路由器,从源代码符和解码器运行前的视角(Sec. 3.1和Fig. 4)来预测这种注意,并调整预先训练的解码器以适应路由器所选择的稀疏的符号子集(Sec. 3. 3)。
每个视线运行的路由器部分在解码器旁边必须花费很少时间,否则路由会使其目的落空:大部分路由器每个场景运行一次,其余的路由器每帧占用12 ms以下的1 ms(底部图2 ).
视图合成还依赖于冗余,因为要估计其深度和外观,就必须在多个来源视图中看到场景的每个部分.
这些观点中编码同一部分的场景的源代码都得到了高度关注,因此仅通过关注排名就将预算花费在了同一部分的场景上多次(图5),我们用非最大程度的压制来解决(第3.2节).

blocks.en:
Two simpler ways of choosing the source tokens fall short of our router ( Sec. 4.4 ).
Ranking the tokens by a geometric cost [ 22 ] computed from depth estimated by MapAnything [ 31 ] ignores which tokens the decoder actually uses, and trails our router by 1.62 dB with 24 source views and one view’s worth of tokens.
Giving the decoder whole source views, as image-based renderers select them [ 59 , 53 ] , is all or nothing: it renders worse with few source views, and it is unstable along a camera path, since parts of the scene vanish or appear whenever the selected view changes ( Fig. 8 ).
Selecting individual source tokens avoids both problems, since each token is chosen for what it contributes to the viewpoint.
blocks.zh:
两种更简单的选择源符的方法与我们的路由器(sec. 4.4)相差甚远.
从MapAnything [31] 估计的深度计算出几何成本,

选择单个的源令牌可以避免这两个问题,因为选择每个令牌是为了它对观点的贡献.

blocks.en: 3.3 Adapting the decoder
blocks.zh: 3.3 调整解码器

blocks.en:
We take the encoder and the decoder from LagerNVS [ 56 ] and keep the encoder frozen.
The pretrained decoder has only attended to all tokens of every source view, whereas the selected tokens are a sparse subset scattered over parts of many views.
We adapt it to such subsets with low-rank updates [ 24 ] to its linear layers, trained with the rendering loss of LagerNVS [ 56 ] on the tokens selected by the frozen router, and we draw the budget at random for every training step, so that a single set of updates serves every budget.
With all source tokens, the updates are switched off, so that our model reduces exactly to LagerNVS [ 56 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们把编码器和解码器从LagerNVS[56] 并保持编码器的冻结.
预训解码器只处理每个源视图的所有符号,而选定的符号是分散在许多视图部分内容的稀有子集.
我们把它适应这样的子集,低级更新[24]到它的线性层,在被冻结的路由器选择的符号上训练LagerNVS[56]的渲染损失,我们为每一个训练步骤随机抽取预算,这样一集更新就可以为每一个预算服务.
有了所有源代码,更新被关闭,这样我们的模型就完全缩小到LagerNVS [56].

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We first measure how routing trades speed for quality as the number of source views grows ( Sec. 4.2 ), then compare our model with feed-forward methods with and without input poses ( Sec. 4.3 ), and analyze its token selection ( Sec. 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先衡量路线交易的速度如何随着源视图数量的增加而提高质量(第4.2节),然后将我们的模型与输入和非输入的输入法进行比较(第4.3节),并分析其符号选择(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en:
We apply our method to two models of LagerNVS [ 56 ] : the model trained on DL3DV [ 41 ] , which renders 256 × 256 256\times 256 views from 2 to 6 posed source views, and the general model, which renders 512 × 512 512\times 512 views from source views with or without poses.
For each, we train the router and adapt the decoder with the training protocol of LagerNVS ( Sec. B ), and with all tokens ( B = N B=N ) our model reduces exactly to its base model.
blocks.zh:
我们把方法应用到两个模型的LagerNVS [56]:一个是经过DL3DV[41]培训的模型,它使256×256/256\时256从2到6的视图提出了源观点,另一个是一般模型,它使512×512/512\时从有或无姿势的源观点得出512.
对于每一个,我们用LagerNVS(Sec. B)的训练协议来训练路由器和调整解码器,并且用所有的符号(B = N B = N),我们的模型精确地缩小到它的基模型.

blocks.en:
With input poses, we evaluate on the 140 scenes of the DL3DV benchmark [ 41 ] , with 4 to 24 source views spread over the first 300 frames of each scene, and on its splits of DepthSplat [ 66 ] and ReSplat [ 67 ] , with 4 to 32 source views.
Without input poses, we evaluate on RealEstate10K [ 82 ] with 2 source views, on the split of NoPoSplat [ 70 ] , and on CO3D [ 46 ] and Mip-NeRF 360 [ 2 ] with 9 source views, on the splits of ReconFusion [ 64 ] . Section B gives the source views and target viewpoints of each benchmark.
blocks.zh:
有了输入姿势,我们评价了DL3DV基准[41]的140个场景,4至24个源视图分布在每个场景的前300帧,以及它的DepthSplatz [66] 和 ReSplatz [67] 的分裂,有4至32个源视图.
没有输入,我们评价RealEstate10K [82] 有2个来源视图,NoPoSplate [70]的拆分,以及CO3D [46] 和Mip-NERF 360 [2] 有9个来源视图,评价重建的拆分[64]. 节次 B给出了每个基准的来源观点和目标观点.

blocks.en:
With input poses, we compare with the feed-forward Gaussian splatting methods DepthSplat [ 66 ] and ReSplat [ 67 ] , and with CLiFT [ 62 ] , which condenses the source tokens of each scene into fewer tokens, all with their public models and the wider inputs of their training.
Without input poses, we compare with NoPoSplat [ 70 ] , SPFSplatV2 [ 25 ] , YoNoSplat [ 71 ] and WorldMirror [ 43 ] .
We report PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS, on the central square of each frame for DL3DV [ 41 ] .
blocks.zh:
有了输入姿势,我们比较了Feed-forward Gaussian的浮雕方法DepthSplact [66]和ReSplact [67],以及CLIFT [62],它们将每个场景的源代币压缩成更少的代币,都与他们的公共模型和更广泛的培训投入.
没有输入姿势,我们与NoPoSPlat[70],SPFSPlatV2[25],YoNoSPlat[71]和WorldMiror[43]作比较.
我们报告PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS, 在每个框架的中央广场上 DL3DV [41].

blocks.en: 4.2 Speed
blocks.zh: 4.2 速度

blocks.en:
Figure 6 : Speed and quality. Frames per second against PSNR on the 140 test scenes of DL3DV [ 41 ] , with 4 to 24 source views (numbers next to the points) spaced evenly over the first 300 frames of each scene and the same 228 target viewpoints per scene at every number of views. B B is the number of source tokens, 1369 per view, that our decoder attends to per frame; teal shows increasing B B at 24 views, up to all 32,856 tokens.
Speed is measured at 256 × 256 256\times 256 on an RTX PRO 5000 and excludes the work done once per scene, such as encoding the source views ( Sec. L ).
blocks.zh:
图6:速度和质量。 在DL3DV [41] 的140个测试场景上,每秒对PSNR的帧数,每个场景的前300帧间距均匀,每个场景的4至24个源视图(点旁边的数字)均匀,每个场景在每一次视图上均匀228个目标视角. 乙级 B是源令牌的数量,每个视图1369个,我们每个帧的解码器都注意;Teal显示B在24个视图中增加,最多达到所有32,856个令牌.
速度以256×256 256\times 256在RTX PRO 5000上测量,不包括每个场景一次完成的工作,例如编码源视图(Sec.L.).

blocks.en:
In Fig. 6 , a better renderer lies further toward the upper right, with a higher PSNR at a higher frame rate.
Routing moves LagerNVS [ 56 ] in this direction: with two views’ worth of tokens, our model renders 82 to 87 frames per second at every number of source views, against 13 to 70 for LagerNVS with all source tokens, with a PSNR at most 0.68 dB lower.
To raise its quality, LagerNVS has to add source views, but every view adds tokens that its decoder attends to in every frame, so going from 4 to 24 views raises its PSNR by 5.7 dB but makes it 5.5 times slower.
With a fixed budget, our model gains 5.1 dB from the same views while its frame rate drops by only 6%, since scoring a source token is far cheaper than attending to it.
Once the source views are given, the budget is also a better way than the number of views to trade quality for speed, as the teal curve of our model, which varies the budget at 24 views, lies above the black curve of LagerNVS, which varies the number of views: to render more than three times as fast as with all tokens of 24 views, our model lowers its budget to a quarter of the tokens and loses 0.28 dB, whereas LagerNVS has to drop to 8 views and loses 2.89 dB.
Since a single ranking serves every budget, this choice can change from one frame to the next without encoding the scene again.
blocks.zh:
以法义. 6,一个更好的渲染器更靠近右上方,一个更高的PSNR,更高的帧率.
Routing将LagerNVS [56] 移动到这个方向:用两种观点值的符牌,我们的模型在每个源值视图中每秒使82到87帧,而所有源值的LagerNVS为13到70帧,最高为0.68 dB。
为了提高其质量,LagerNVS必须添加源视图,但每个视图都添加其解码器在每个帧中注意的符号,因此从4到24个视图将它的PSNR提高了5.7 dB,但使其慢了5.5倍.
以固定预算,我们的模型从同样的观点中获得了5.1 dB,而其帧率只下降了6%,因为得分的源值远比关注源值便宜。
一旦给出了来源视图,预算也是比以速度换取交易质量的视图数量更好的方式,因为我们模式的teal曲线以24视图来改变预算,它位于LagerNVS的黑色曲线上方,它改变了视图数量:要让预算比所有24视图的符号快3倍以上,我们模式将其预算降到1/4的符号,损失0.28 dB,而LagerNVS不得不降到8视图,损失2.89 dB.
由于单次排名服务于每一个预算,因此这一选择可以从一个帧变化到下一个帧,而无需再次编码场景.

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with prior methods
blocks.zh: 4.3 与以往方法的比较

blocks.en:
Table 1 : Comparison without input poses on RealEstate10K [ 82 ] (NoPoSplat [ 70 ] split, scored at 256 × 256 256\times 256 ), CO3D [ 46 ] and Mip-NeRF 360 [ 2 ] (ReconFusion [ 64 ] splits, scored at 512 × 512 512\times 512 ).
Every method estimates and refines the target pose. ∗ Numbers from the papers. † Trained on CO3D.
Ours builds on the general model of LagerNVS [ 56 ] and reduces to it with all tokens (gray); 1369 tokens are one view.
FPS counts target viewpoints rendered per second on one RTX PRO 5000 once the scene is encoded, with the fastest renderer that reproduces each splatting method’s images, at the refined target pose and excluding the refinement ( Tab. S18 ).
Colors mark the best , second and third entry in each quality column of each block, excluding the gray rows.
blocks.zh:
表1:无输入比较在RealEstate10K [82](No PoSPlat [70] 拆分,得分256×256\times 256),CO3D [46]和Mip-NERF 360 [2](Reconfunction [64] 拆分,得分512×512 512\times 512)上.
每一种方法都估计和完善目标姿势。 * 论文中的数字。
我们的作品建立在LagerNVS[56]的通用模型之上,并用所有的符号(gray)减少;1369个符号是一景.
FPS计算一个RTX PRO 5000在现场编码后每秒提供的目标视点,其中最快的渲染器复制了每种镀层方法的图像,在精细的目标姿势上,不包括精度(Tab.S18)。
颜色在每一块的每个质量栏中标出最佳,第二和第三个条目,不包括灰色行.

blocks.en:
With one view’s worth of tokens, our model outperforms every pose-free baseline on all three benchmarks, the strongest by 1.1 to 3.4 dB in PSNR, and with three views’ worth of the nine on CO3D and Mip-NeRF 360, it stays within 0.25 dB of LagerNVS [ 56 ] ( Tab. 1 ).
Following the protocol of NoPoSplat [ 70 ] , every method in Tab. 1 estimates the target pose and refines it against the target image before scoring, a step needed only for evaluation, and our router selects its tokens once from the initial pose.
blocks.zh:
从一种观点看,我们的模型在所有三个基准上都超过了每个无姿势基线,在PSNR中最强的是1.1到3.4 dB,在CO3D和Mip-NeRF 360上的9个基准中,它的3个值保持在LagerNVS[56]的0.25 dB(附件1)。
遵循NoPoSplate[70]的协议,Tab中的每一种方法. 1在评分前估计目标摆位并比目标图像精细化,这个步骤只是评价所需的,我们的路由器从最初的姿势中选择过一次它的标志.

blocks.en:
On DL3DV ( Tabs. S1 and S2 ), one view’s worth of tokens outperforms DepthSplat [ 66 ] and CLiFT [ 62 ] by over 3 dB with 4 and 6 views.
Our model outperforms ReSplat [ 67 ] at 8 views with any budget and at 16 views from two views’ worth, with lower LPIPS throughout, and trails it by 0.1 to 0.3 dB at 32 views, where ReSplat falls to 27.60 dB on our crops.
blocks.zh:
在DL3DV(Tabs. S1和S2)上,一个景点的标语价值超过了深度标语[66]和CLiFT[62],超过3 dB,有4和6个视图.
我们的模型在8个观点中比ReSplaint [67] 优于8个观点,从两个观点的价值中得出16个观点,整个LPIPS更低,在32个观点中以0.1到0.3 dB跟踪它,而ReSplaint在我们的作物上降为27.60 dB。

blocks.en: Once their Gaussians are predicted, the splatting methods render a frame 3 to 21 times faster than our model with one view’s worth of tokens, since rasterizing Gaussians costs far less than running a transformer decoder, whereas ours renders 1.2 to 12 times faster than LagerNVS [ 56 ] , with the largest gains for the most source views ( Tab. 1 and Tab. S18 ).
blocks.zh: 一旦他们的高斯人被预言,镀层方法使一个帧比我们的模型快3到21倍,只值一个景物,因为光栅化的高斯人的成本远低于运行一个变压器解码器,而我们的光栅化比LagerNVS[56]快1.2到12倍,对大多数源视图来说收益最大(Tab.1和Tab.S18)。

blocks.en: 4.4 Selection strategies
blocks.zh: 4.4 甄选战略

blocks.en:
Figure 7 : Selection strategies. PSNR with one view’s worth of source tokens ( B = 1369 B=1369 ) on the 140 test scenes of DL3DV [ 41 ] , with 4 to 24 source views spaced evenly over the first 300 frames and the same 228 target viewpoints per scene.
Each strategy renders through a decoder adapted to its own selections in the same way as ours, and LagerNVS [ 56 ] attends to all source tokens.
blocks.zh:
图7:甄选战略。 PSNR在DL3DV[41]的140个测试场景上以一个视图值的源代号(B = 1369 B = 1369)表示,4至24个源的视图在前300帧的空间上均匀,每个场景有相同的228个目标视角.
每一种策略都通过一个适应自身选择的解码器与我们的一样,LagerNVS [56] 关注所有源代码.

blocks.en:
Figure 8 : Switching source views along a 300-frame trajectory, with four source views captured at the vertical lines.
The whole view ( orange ) is the source view from which our router selects the most tokens, and tags mark the views it uses at t − 1 t{-}1 and t t ; blue lanes show the share of our router’s tokens from each view, and the views show its tokens at frame t t .
At the marked switch, the boxed content turns translucent with the whole view, while our router keeps 95% of its tokens. Figures S3 and S4 show further switches, also with two views’ worth of tokens.
blocks.zh:
图8:沿300帧轨迹切换源视图,在垂直线上捕捉到4个源视图.
整个视图(橙色)是源视图,我们路由器从中选择了最多的路由符,标记它所使用的视图在 t − 1 t{} 1 和 t ;蓝色通道显示我们路由器的路由符从每个视图中所占的份额,视图显示它的路由符在frame t t 中.
在标记开关时,箱装内容会随着全景而变透明,而我们的路由器则保留95%的代币. 图S3和S4显示进一步的开关,还有两种观点值的信号。

blocks.en:
Figure 7 compares our router with other ways of choosing the source tokens, each rendered through a decoder adapted to its own selections in the same way as ours, with one view’s worth of tokens.
The gap between our model and LagerNVS [ 56 ] with all tokens grows with the number of views, from 0.29 to 1.86 dB, since this budget is an ever smaller share of the source tokens, down to 4% with 24 views, but doubling the budget to two views’ worth already closes it to 0.68 dB ( Fig. 6 ).
blocks.zh:
图7比较了我们的路由器和其他选择源代币的方法, 每种方式都通过一个适应自己选择的解码器,
我们的模型和LagerNVS[56]与所有符号之间的差距随着浏览量的增长而增加,从0.29到1.86 dB,因为这一预算在源代码中所占的份额越来越小,在24个视图中下降到4%,但预算翻一番到两个视图的价值已经接近0.68 dB(图6)。

blocks.en:
The other strategies in Fig. 7 choose tokens as follows: • Ours without NMS uses a router trained to rank the tokens by their attention mass alone ( Eq. 4 ). • Whole view gives the decoder all tokens of the source view from which our router selects the most tokens.
It renders 0.1 to 0.2 dB better than the source view nearest to the target viewpoint, which the appendix compares as well.
Image-based renderers [ 59 , 53 ] select their source views by such proximity in pose, as do generative view synthesis models when they retrieve views from a memory [ 81 ] ; we measure it with the distance of GP-MVS [ 23 ] , which combines translation and rotation. • Geometric cost ranks the tokens by the per-pixel cost that Deep Blending [ 22 ] computes from depth, viewing angle and distance, with depth from MapAnything [ 31 ] . • Random tokens are drawn uniformly per viewpoint.
blocks.zh:
图7中的其他战略选择如下: 没有NMS的我们使用一个经过训练的路由器,单凭其注意力量来排列符号(Eq.4 ). 全视图给出了源视图的所有符号解码器,我们路由器从中选择了最多的符号.
它使0.1至0.2 dB比源视图更接近目标视角,附录对此也作了比较。
基于图像的渲染器[59,53]通过如此近的姿势来选择其源视图,当它们从内存中获取视图时的基因视图合成模型[81]也是如此;我们用GP-MVS[23]的距离来测量它,它结合了翻译和旋转. • 几何成本按深度、视角和距离计算出的深度和深度按每像素成本排序 每个视图均统一绘制随机符号。

blocks.en: Ours without NMS uses a router trained to rank the tokens by their attention mass alone ( Eq. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 没有NMS的我们使用一个经过训练的路由器,仅用它们的注意力量来排列符号(Eq.4 ).

blocks.en:
Whole view gives the decoder all tokens of the source view from which our router selects the most tokens.
It renders 0.1 to 0.2 dB better than the source view nearest to the target viewpoint, which the appendix compares as well.
Image-based renderers [ 59 , 53 ] select their source views by such proximity in pose, as do generative view synthesis models when they retrieve views from a memory [ 81 ] ; we measure it with the distance of GP-MVS [ 23 ] , which combines translation and rotation.
blocks.zh:
全视图给出了源视图的所有符号解码器,我们路由器从中选择了最多的符号.
它使0.1至0.2 dB比源视图更接近目标视角,附录对此也作了比较。
基于图像的渲染器[59,53]通过如此近的姿势来选择其源视图,当它们从内存中获取视图时的基因视图合成模型[81]也是如此;我们用GP-MVS[23]的距离来测量它,它结合了翻译和旋转.

blocks.en: Geometric cost ranks the tokens by the per-pixel cost that Deep Blending [ 22 ] computes from depth, viewing angle and distance, with depth from MapAnything [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 几何成本按每像素成本排序 深闪烁[22]从深度,视角和距离计算,深度从MapAnything [31].

blocks.en: Random tokens are drawn uniformly per viewpoint.
blocks.zh: 每个视图均统一绘制随机符号。

blocks.en:
Our router outperforms all of them with 4 views; as views are added, the gap to the whole view closes, from 0.81 to 0.06 dB with 24 views, where the two are on par, since denser source views make it more likely that one nearly coincides with the target viewpoint.
The gap to our model without NMS instead grows, from 0.21 to 1.51 dB, since denser source views encode the same surfaces several times, and ranking by attention mass alone spends the budget on them.
The geometric cost comes closest to our router with 4 views, 0.31 dB below it, but levels off from 16 views, as random tokens do from 12, and trails it by 1.62 dB with 24 views.
blocks.zh:
我们的路由器以4种观点超越了所有这些观点;随着观点的加入,整个视图的缺口从0.81到0.06 dB的24种观点相近,因为两者处于平价状态,因为更稠密的来源观点使得一个观点更可能与目标观点接近一致.
与我们的模型相比,没有NMS的差距从0.21增长到1.51 dB,因为更稠密的源代码将相同的表面编码了好几次,仅根据注意力量来排序就把预算花在了它们上.
几何成本最接近我们的路由器,有4个视图,低于0.31 dB,但从16个视图中平移,如随机符号从12个视图中平移,以1.62 dB跟踪它,共24个视图.

blocks.en:
Whole views also make the rendering unstable along a camera path, since each change of the selected view replaces all the tokens that the decoder sees, so that parts of the scene vanish, turn translucent or appear from one frame to the next ( Fig. 8 ).
With four source views, the whole view changes 8 times over 300 frames on average, and at these switches its PSNR changes by 1.51 dB from one frame to the next, about four times as much as between other frames.
Our router keeps 93% of its tokens at these switches, and its PSNR changes by only 0.28 dB there, as much as that of LagerNVS [ 56 ] with all tokens.
The appendix repeats Fig. 7 with two views’ worth of tokens and adds the nearest source view and the selection rule of CLiFT [ 62 ] ( Sec. J ).
blocks.zh:
整体视图也使得渲染沿相机路径不稳定,因为每次对所选视图的更改都会取代解码器所看到的所有符号,这样部分场景就会消失,变透明或者从一个帧到下一个帧出现(图8).
有了4个源视图,全景平均变化超过300帧8倍,在这些切换中,它的PSNR变化从一个帧到另一个帧的1.51 dB,大约是其他帧之间的4倍.
我们的路由器在这些交换机上保留了93%的代号,它的PSNR在那里的改变只有0.28 dB,就像所有代号的LagerNVS [56]一样.
附录重复了图7,其中包含两种观点的符号值,并增加了最近的源视图和CLIFT[62]的选择规则(Sec.J.).

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Classical rendering pipelines have long rasterized only what a viewpoint sees, and our results suggest that transformer-based view synthesis models can learn to do the same from their own attention.
To achieve this, we use the intuition that each source token acts as a local anchor, similar to a mesh element, and hence, each target token only needs to attend to a small set of source tokens.
We design a token routing scheme that keeps the quality of transformer-based view synthesis models while their rendering time per viewpoint barely grows with the number of source views.
blocks.zh:
古典的渲染管道只把一个观点所看到的光线化了,我们的结果表明,基于变压器的透视合成模型可以从自己的注意力中学习做同样的事情.
为了达到这个目的,我们使用直觉,每个源符作为局部锚,类似于网状元素,因此,每个目标符只需要关注一小组源符.
我们设计了一种符号路由方案,它保持了基于变压器的视图合成模型的质量,而其每个视图的渲染时间却随着源视图的数量而几乎没有增长.

blocks.en:
On hardware with little compute bandwidth, transformer-based view synthesis models remain a poor fit even with token routing, given their current size.
Below one view’s worth of tokens, the quality of our model drops quickly ( Sec. F ), while its rendering time barely decreases, because every target token still passes through the full decoder.
Complementary reductions, such as smaller distilled decoders, lower numerical precision or fewer target tokens, may eventually make these models practical on such hardware.
blocks.zh:
在几乎没有计算带宽的硬件上,基于变压器的视线合成模型,考虑到其当前大小,即使有符号路由,仍然不合适.
我们的模型质量迅速下降(Sec.F.), 而它的渲染时间却几乎没有减少, 因为每个目标符号仍然通过完全的解码器。
补充的还原,如更小的蒸馏解码器,更低的数值精度或更小的目标符号,最终可能会使这些模型在这种硬件上实用.

blocks.en:
The issue of compute bandwidth gets all the more important for streaming applications, where the encoding needs to happen in real time as well.
Token routing only speeds up rendering, not the encoding of the source views, whose time grows with their number.
Here, ideas from streaming geometry transformers [ 83 , 35 , 60 ] could make the encoders of view synthesis models faster and let them take in source views as they arrive.
blocks.zh:
计算带宽问题对流化应用更加重要,其中编码也需要实时进行.
Token路由只加速渲染,而不是源视图的编码,其时间随其数量而增加.
在这里,流线几何变压器的构思[83,35,60]可以使视图合成模型的编码器更快,并让它们在到达时接收源视图.

blocks.en:
Our router prunes source tokens rather than merging them, a choice on which studies of token reduction in image classification disagree [ 4 , 20 , 34 ] .
Pruning suits our setting because one ranking of the tokens serves every budget, so the budget can change at render time, even between frames.
Yet classical approaches to content synthesis avoid redundancy in their representations by merging scans of an object or scene into a single consistent mesh.
Our approach would benefit from such merging, which reduces the number of source tokens to prune.
blocks.zh:
我们的路由器 prunes source orders 而不是合并它们, 对于这个选择, 符号减少图像分类的研究 不同意 [4, 20, 34].
跑步适合我们的设定,因为每个预算都有一个符号的排序,所以预算可以随时间而变化,甚至在框架之间。
然而,对内容合成的经典方法通过将一个物体或场景的扫描合并为一个一致的网格来避免其表达中的冗余.
我们的做法将受益于这种合并,这种合并减少了源代币的数量。

blocks.en: Another limitation of transformer-based rendering is that we have no graceful approach to handling resolution/scale. Consider a large scene rendered from a distant viewpoint; the lack of scale implies that we will attend to a large collection of source tokens whose contribution in the target image could even be smaller than a pixel. All of this necessitates a broader range of operations for token-based representations, akin to what has been developed for meshes.
blocks.zh: 基于变压器的渲染的另一个局限性是,我们在处理分辨率/尺度方面没有优雅的方法。 从遥远的角度考虑一个大的场景;没有尺度意味着我们将处理大量源代码的集合,它们在目标图像中的贡献甚至可能比像素小. 所有这些都要求为象征性的表述采取更广泛的行动,这类似于为网状体开发的做法。

blocks.en: This appendix gives the details of our experiments and additional results. Section B describes the training, the benchmarks, the inputs of the baselines and the pose-free protocol, and Sec. C gives our comparison with input poses and the full version of Tab. 1 . Section D compares the publicly available models of ReSplat [ 67 ] , Sec. E evaluates our model without fine-tuning at the test view count, Sec. F reports budgets below one view’s worth of tokens, Sec. G adds further pose-free methods and view counts, Sec. H illustrates our non-maximum suppression, Sec. I compares the decoder blocks from which the labels can be computed, Sec. J adds further selection strategies, Sec. K shows further view switches, and Sec. L gives the measurements behind the speed analysis, with timings at 512 × 512 512\times 512 . Section M repeats the comparison with input poses on the ReSplat split with the target pose refined as in the pose-free protocol.

blocks.en:
As in Sec. 4.1 , we apply our method to two released models of LagerNVS [ 56 ] , with a router and a decoder adaptation of its own for each.
The model trained on DL3DV [ 41 ] renders 256 × 256 256\times 256 views from 2 to 6 posed source views, and all our experiments with input poses build on it: the speed and selection experiments of Secs. 4.2 and 4.4 , the comparisons on DL3DV ( Secs. C , E , F and M ) and Secs. H , I , J and K .
The general model renders 512 × 512 512\times 512 views from 1 to 10 source views with or without their poses, and we use it only for the comparison without input poses, in Tabs. 1 , S3 , S4 and S5 and Sec. G , and for the timing at 512 × 512 512\times 512 in Tab. S17 .
blocks.zh:
如同第4.1节,我们把方法应用到两个发布型号的LagerNVS [56] 上,每个型号都有路由器和自己的解码器改造.
对DL3DV[41]进行训练的模型使256×256\时从2到6的256个观点提出了源头观点,我们所有输入的实验都以此为基础:4.2和4.4塞克的速度和选择实验,DL3DV(C、E、F和M塞克)和H、I、J和K塞克的比较。
一般型号使512×512 512\时从1到10个来源视图中产生512个有或无其姿势的视图,我们只用它来比较没有输入的姿势,在Tabs. 1,S3,S4和S5以及Sec. G中,时间为512×512 512\时. S17中.

blocks.en:
For the model of LagerNVS [ 56 ] trained on DL3DV [ 41 ] , we train the router from scratch for 100k iterations, with labels computed from the sixth of the twelve decoder blocks, which Sec. I compares with other blocks.
We then adapt the decoder for 100k iterations with rank-32 low-rank updates [ 24 ] to all of its linear layers, which amount to 12.6 M trainable parameters, or 6.6% of the decoder.
During adaptation, the budget is drawn log-uniformly between half a view (685 tokens) and all N N tokens, and one step in ten uses all tokens.
Both stages are trained on DL3DV-10K [ 41 ] with the training protocol of LagerNVS, with 2 to 6 source views and eight target viewpoints per scene, and take about 1.3 and 1.4 days on eight H200 GPUs.
For the general model of LagerNVS, we train the router and adapt the decoder in the same way, for 100k iterations each, with the training protocol of that model, which samples 1 to 10 source views with or without their poses.
With all tokens ( B = N B=N ), the updates are not applied, so that our model reduces exactly to LagerNVS.
blocks.zh:
对于LagerNVS[56]在DL3DV[41]上训练的型号,我们从零开始训练路由器,进行100k的迭代,标签从12个解码器块中的第6个计算,Sec. 我比其他街区。
然后将100k迭代的编解码器与等级-32低级更新[24]调整到其所有线性层,相当于12.6M的可训练参数,即解码器的6.6%.
在适应期间,预算在半视差(685个符)和所有NN符之间划出对数统一,十中一步使用所有符.
两个阶段都通过LagerNVS的训练协议对DL3DV-10K[41]进行了训练,每个场景有2至6个源视图和8个目标视角,8个H200GPU需要约1.3和1.4天.
对于LagerNVS的一般模型,我们以同样的方式训练路由器,并调整解码器,每个100k的迭代,与该模型的训练协议,该协议对1到10个源视图进行样本,无论是否有姿势.
有了所有符号(B = N B = N),更新不应用,因此我们的模型完全缩小到LagerNVS.

The DepthSplat split [ 66 ] places 4 or 6 source views within the first 50 frames of each of the 140 scenes of the DL3DV benchmark [ 41 ] , and, as in LagerNVS [ 56 ] , we render the remaining 46 or 44 frames of this window, so that no source view is also a target.
The ReSplat split [ 67 ] uses 8, 16 or 32 source views that span 40, 80 or 160 frames, with 8, 16 or 24 target viewpoints per scene that are disjoint from the sources.
Its splits for different view counts contain different targets and differ in difficulty, so results are comparable only within a view count.
For the experiments on speed and selection, we place K K source views at frames round ⁡ ( 299 ​ k / ( K − 1 ) ) \mathrm{round}(299\,k/(K-1)) , k = 0 , … , K − 1 k=0,\dots,K-1 , of the first 300 frames of each scene, for K K from 4 to 24, and render the same 228 target viewpoints per scene at every K K , namely the frames that are a source view at no K K .
Without input poses, RealEstate10K [ 82 ] uses the 5,601 test scenes of the split of NoPoSplat [ 70 ] , scored at 256 × 256 256\times 256 with its protocol and metric code, and CO3D [ 46 ] and Mip-NeRF 360 [ 2 ] use the 20 sequences and 9 scenes of the splits of ReconFusion [ 64 ] , scored at 512 × 512 512\times 512 with the metric code of LagerNVS.

blocks.en:
Like LagerNVS [ 56 ] , our model operates on the central 540 × 540 540\times 540 square of each 960 × 540 960\times 540 frame of DL3DV [ 41 ] , resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , and we score all methods on these crops.
DepthSplat [ 66 ] , ReSplat [ 67 ] and CLiFT [ 62 ] are trained on 256 × 448 256\times 448 inputs taken from 270 × 480 270\times 480 versions of the same frames.
DepthSplat crops its inputs from these frames, so that they cover 1.66 times the width and 0.95 times the height of our crops, while ReSplat and CLiFT resize the frames, so that their inputs cover 1.75 times the width at the same height. In the main text, the baselines receive these wider inputs, with which they score higher, and Tabs. S1 and S2 also give DepthSplat and ReSplat the same square crops as our model.
blocks.zh:
和LagerNVS [56]一样,我们的型号运行于中央540×540 540\时的540平方,每960×540 960\时的540帧DL3DV [41],大小调整到256×256/256\时的256,我们对这些作物的所有方法都得分.
深度Splate [66],ReSplate [67] 和CLIFT [62] 培训内容为256×448 256\time的448个输入,取自270×480270\time的480个版本相同的帧.
深度Splate作物从这些帧中输入,这样它们能覆盖我们作物的1.66倍宽度和0.95倍高度,而ReSplate和CLIFT则调整帧大小,使其输入量覆盖同一高度的1.75倍宽度. 在正文中,基线接收到这些更广泛的投入,并以此获得更高的分数,以及Tabs. S1和S2还给深色板和ReSplat提供了与我们的模型相同的方块作物.

blocks.en:
For DepthSplat [ 66 ] , we use its model trained on DL3DV [ 41 ] with 2 to 6 source views.
ReSplat [ 67 ] provides a separate model for each view count, and we use its base model with four refinement iterations, its strongest available configuration on this benchmark ( Sec. D ).
For CLiFT [ 62 ] , we use its model trained on DL3DV with 4 to 6 source views, with one cluster per source token, so that it keeps all of its tokens, its highest-quality setting.
Since the release of DL3DV from which CLiFT reads its frames is incomplete for 8 of the benchmark scenes, we give it the same frames and cameras as every other method, downsampled to the 270 × 480 270\times 480 frames of its training and resized by its own code. Under their original evaluation protocols, DepthSplat and ReSplat reproduce the results reported by their authors to within 0.07 dB, and CLiFT, with the frames of the release, matches its published results on DL3DV, which are given only as plots, to within about 0.1 dB. Because each model of ReSplat is trained for a single view count, on the ReSplat split we fine-tune our router and decoder at each view count, for 2k iterations each, with the view sampling used to train ReSplat and our square crops ( Sec. E ).
blocks.zh:
对于深度Splate [66],我们使用其模式在DL3DV[41]上训练有素,有2到6个源视图.
ReSplace [67] 为每个视图计数提供了单独的模型,我们使用其基础模型有四个精细的迭代,在这个基准(Sec. D.)上它最强的现有配置.
对于CLIFT [62],我们使用它训练在DL3DV上的模型,有4到6个源视图,每个源代码有一个集群,这样它就能保留它的所有符,其最高质量的设置.
由于CLIFT从中读取其帧的DL3DV的发布对于8个基准场景来说是不完整的,因此我们给它提供了与所有其他方法相同的帧和相机,被取样为270×480270\时的480帧训练,并用自己的代码调整了尺寸. 根据其最初的评价协议,深度Splatz和ReSplatz复制了作者在0.07 dB范围内报告的结果,CLIFT在发布框架下,将其在DL3DV上公布的结果与仅作为地块给出的,在0.1 dB范围内. 因为ReSpla特的每个模型都是为单一的视图计数而训练的,所以在ReSpla特的分数上,我们微调了我们的路由器,并在每个视图计数上解码器,每个重置2k倍数,并带有用于训练ReSpla特和我们方块作物的视图采样(sec. E.).

blocks.en:
Following NoPoSplat [ 70 ] , every method estimates the target pose from the target image and refines it with 100 Adam steps at a learning rate of 0.005 on the mean squared error plus 0.05 times the LPIPS between the rendered and the target image.
Our router selects the tokens once from the initial target pose, and the selection is held fixed during refinement, which changes the PSNR by at most 0.06 dB compared with selecting the tokens again at every step.
For YoNoSplat [ 71 ] , we report the stronger of its own test-time alignment and this refinement, and WorldMirror [ 43 ] starts the refinement from its own predicted target pose; both receive the ground-truth intrinsics.
The numbers of NoPoSplat and SPFSplatV2 [ 25 ] are taken from their papers.
blocks.zh:
在NoPoSplat [70] 之后,每一种方法都从目标图像中估计出目标布局,并用100个亚当步骤对其进行精炼,在平均平方误差上以0.005的学习速度加上渲染与目标图像之间的LPIPS的0.05倍.
我们的路由器从初始目标姿势中选择了一次符号,选择在完善时被固定,这与每个步骤再次选择符号相比,PSNR最多会改变0.06 dB.
对于YoNoSplat [71],我们报告说,它自己的测试时间调整和这一改进更加有力,而WorldMirror [43] 则从它自己预测的目标姿势开始完善;两者都得到了地真相的内在体现。
NoPoSPlat和SPFSPlatV2[25]的编号取自他们的论文.

ReSplat [ 67 ] predicts an initial set of 3D Gaussians and then refines it over several iterations.
Its publicly available larger model has no refinement stage. Table S6 compares the 8-view models on the 8-view ReSplat split [ 67 ] , with 256 × 448 256\times 448 inputs and the scoring of Tab. S2 .
Without refinement, the larger model improves over the base model by 0.4 dB.
With four refinement iterations, the base model reaches 29.14 dB, 1.4 dB above the larger model, and we therefore use it in the main text.
With square inputs, the ranking is the same, with 24.66, 25.02 and 27.78 dB for the three rows of the table.

blocks.en: Appendix I Label block

blocks.en:
Our router learns from the attention in the sixth of the twelve decoder blocks of LagerNVS [ 56 ] ( Sec. B ), a choice we compare here with blocks 2, 4, 8 and 10.
Training a router for every block would be costly, so we instead select the tokens of each target viewpoint directly with the labels of each block, computed with the frozen decoder and all source tokens, and adapt the decoder to these selections for 20k iterations with the recipe of Sec. B .
The five adaptations differ only in the block, with the same seed and the same sequence of scenes, source views, target viewpoints and budgets, and with block 6 the selections are exactly the labels that our router learns from.
We evaluate on 32 scenes of DL3DV-10K [ 41 ] that are excluded from all our training and from every benchmark split, though not from the training of LagerNVS, with 4, 8 and 16 source views spaced evenly over the first 300 frames and the same 60 target viewpoints per scene for every number of source views.

训练每个区块的路由器成本很高,所以我们直接用每个区块的标签选择每个目标视线的符号,用冷冻的解码器和所有源代码计算,并用Sec.B的配方调整解码器以适应20k的这些选择。
这五部改编作品仅在区块上有所不同,种子和场景顺序相同,源头视图,目标观点和预算相同,而第6区块的选择正是我们的路由器从中学习的标签.
我们对32场DL3DV-10K[41]的场景进行评估,这些场景被排除在我们的所有训练之外,也被排除在每个基准的划分之外,尽管不是来自LagerNVS的训练,其中4,8和16个源视图在前300帧之间均匀分布,每个场景对每一个源视图的相同60个目标视角.

blocks.en: Appendix J Selection strategies
blocks.zh: 附录J 甄选战略

blocks.en:
Table S14 gives the numbers behind Fig. 7 , repeats them with two views’ worth of tokens, and adds two further strategies, the source view nearest to the target viewpoint and the selection rule of CLiFT [ 62 ] .
Each strategy has its own decoder, adapted in the same way as ours ( Sec. B ) with the selections of the strategy in place of those of the router, and no strategy sees the target image.
The strategies choose the source tokens as follows: • Ours without NMS uses a router trained to rank the tokens by their attention mass alone ( Eq. 4 ). • Whole view keeps the source view from which our router selects the most tokens. • Nearest view keeps the source view whose camera is nearest to the target viewpoint, measured with the distance in pose space of GP-MVS [ 23 ] , which combines translation and rotation; image-based renderers [ 59 , 53 ] likewise select their source views by proximity in pose, as do generative view synthesis models when they retrieve views from a memory [ 81 ] , each with its own distance. • Geometric cost renders the depth that MapAnything [ 31 ] estimates for the source views into the target image, computes for every visible source pixel the cost of Deep Blending [ 22 ] , a weighted sum of depth, viewing-angle and distance terms, and scores each token in each of the 37 × 37 37\times 37 cells of the target image by its largest cost over the pixels of the cell where it is visible.
It then fills the budget in rounds, each of which takes the best remaining token of every cell, as Inside-Out [ 21 ] selects contributions per cell. • CLiFT rule applies the token selection that CLiFT [ 62 ] performs at render time to our tokens: each patch of a coarse grid over the target image takes the source tokens closest to it, by the angle between their rays and the ray of the patch and by the distance between the cameras, and the rest of the budget is filled globally. • Random tokens are drawn uniformly from all source tokens for every target viewpoint. With one view’s worth of tokens, the whole view outperforms the nearest view by 0.1 to 0.2 dB at every number of views, and the CLiFT rule [ 62 ] trails the geometric cost by 0.2 to 0.8 dB and outperforms random tokens by only 0.04 dB with 4 views.
With two views’ worth, the whole view and the nearest view keep a pair of views, our router again outperforms every other strategy up to 16 views, and the whole view is on par with it from 20 views on, within 0.05 dB.

blocks.en:
Table S15 lists the measurements behind Fig. 6 .
We time every setting on one otherwise idle RTX PRO 5000 GPU at 256 × 256 256\times 256 , in bf16 and with one target viewpoint per frame, and capture the rendering of a frame once as a CUDA graph that is then replayed, for our model and for LagerNVS [ 56 ] alike.
For both models, all work that depends only on the scene is done once per scene and excluded from the time per frame: the encoding of the source views, the projections of the source tokens in the first decoder block and, for our model, the scene branch of the router.
The time per frame thus comprises the camera conditioning and the decoder, and for our model also the target branch of the router, the scoring of all source tokens and the selection of the top B B ; we report its median over 300 frames along the target viewpoints of each of three scenes.
The timed code renders the same images as the code used for evaluation, up to rounding differences that arise from processing one frame at a time.
At a fixed budget, the time per frame of our model still grows slightly with the number of source views, from 7.64 to 8.37 ms between 4 and 24 views with 1369 tokens, because the router scores all source tokens for every frame.
blocks.zh:
表S15列出了图6后面的测量数据。
我们以256×256 256\times 256的bf16和每个帧一个目标视角,对一个原本闲置的RTX PRO 5000 GPU的每个设置进行时间,并捕获一个帧的渲染一次作为CUDA图,然后作为我们的模型和LagerNVS[56]的重播。
对于两个模型来说,所有只取决于场景的作品都是每个场景完成一次,并且从每个帧的时间中排除:源视图的编码,第一个解码器块中源信号的预测,以及对于我们的模型,路由器的场景分支.
每个帧的时间包括相机的调制和解码器,对于我们的模型来说,还有路由器的目标分支,所有源符的评分和最高BB的选择;我们按照三个场景中每个场景的目标角度报告其中位数超过300帧.
定时代码制作的图像与用于评价的代码相同,最多可以四舍五入一次处理一个帧所产生的差异.
在固定的预算中,我们模型的每个帧的时间仍然随着源视图的数量而略有增长,从7.64米到8.37毫秒不等的4至24个视图,并带有1369个符号,因为路由器对每个帧的所有源值进行评分.

blocks.en:
Table S16 reports the work done once per scene.
The encoder, which LagerNVS [ 56 ] runs as well, takes 133 ms with 4 source views and 1.37 s with 24, and the scene branch of the router adds 29 to 44% to this time.
The time that routing saves on every frame recovers the scene branch within 6 to 14 frames, and within 10 frames from 8 source views on.

blocks.en:
We repeat the timing at 512 × 512 512\times 512 with the general model of LagerNVS [ 56 ] , which we use in the pose-free comparison, and with our router and adapted renderer for it ( Tab. S17 ).
Since the time per frame does not depend on the content of the scene, we only time this model, with the scenes, source views, target poses and protocol used above; its source views also contribute 1369 tokens each.
With all tokens, the frame rate falls from 28.5 FPS at 4 views to 7.7 FPS at 24 views, and with 9 views, the largest number with which LagerNVS [ 56 ] reports real-time rendering on an H100 GPU, it reaches 17.9 FPS on our GPU.
At a fixed budget, our model stays above 40 FPS with 1369 tokens and above 33 FPS with 2738 tokens at every number of views, and with 24 views it renders 5.3 and 4.3 times as many frames per second as LagerNVS [ 56 ] .
These speed-ups are smaller than at 256 × 256 256\times 256 , because the four times larger number of target tokens raises the part of the cost per frame that does not depend on the source tokens.
With 24 views, budgets of 4107, 8214 and 16,428 tokens give 28.7, 22.3 and 14.0 FPS, and the costs per scene are within 2% of those in Tab. S16 , since the encoder resizes its input views to the same size at both resolutions.

Table S18 gives the speed of every method in Tabs. S1 and S2 and in Tab. 1 , timed on one otherwise idle RTX PRO 5000 GPU with one target viewpoint per call, at the resolution at which each table scores, and with the configuration that produced each method’s numbers.
We time each Gaussian splatting method with its own renderer and with gsplat and the original rasterizer of 3D Gaussian Splatting, and the main text reports the fastest renderer that reproduces the method’s images, with a PSNR above 50 dB or a largest difference below 1/255 against its own renderer.
CLiFT [ 62 ] renders in half precision from a CUDA graph, as our model and LagerNVS [ 56 ] do, and renders its full 256 × 448 256\times 448 view, from which the scored square is taken.
The time per scene covers the prediction of the Gaussians, including the four refinement iterations of ReSplat [ 67 ] , the encoder and the clustering of CLiFT, and the encoder of LagerNVS together with, for our model, the scene branch of the router.
The pose refinement that precedes rendering in the pose-free comparison is not included and takes 6.1 to 10.1 s per target viewpoint for our model, 7.3 to 18.8 s for LagerNVS and 0.8 to 7.5 s for the Gaussian splatting methods.

blocks.en: Appendix M Refining the target pose with input poses
blocks.zh: 附件 M 用输入形式修改目标姿势

blocks.en:
On the ReSplat split ( Tab. S2 ), our model is ahead of ReSplat [ 67 ] in PSNR and SSIM with 8 views but behind in four of the six settings with 16 and 32 views, whereas its LPIPS is lower in all nine settings, by 0.011 to 0.043.
We attribute this to a small misalignment of our renders.
Like LagerNVS [ 56 ] , our model takes the target viewpoint as an input and renders it in a coordinate system that the network constructs implicitly, rather than by rasterizing explicit Gaussians with the given camera, as ReSplat does.
The rendered image can therefore be slightly shifted or warped relative to the target image.
Such shifts are hard to see but are penalized heavily by pixel-wise metrics such as PSNR and SSIM, and much less by LPIPS.
LagerNVS shows the same pattern: with 32 views, its PSNR is 0.48 dB below that of ReSplat, while its LPIPS is 0.074 against 0.101.
blocks.zh:
在ReSplate拆分(Tab. S2)上,我们的模型在PSNR和SSIM中领先ReSplate [67],拥有8个视图,但在有16个和32个视图的6个设置中的4个设置中落后,而其LPIPS在所有9个设置中都较低,比0.011到0.043.
我们将此归咎于我们小小的错位。
和LagerNVS [56]一样,我们的模型将目标视角作为输入,使其在网络隐含构造的坐标系统中,而不是像ReSplat那样用给定的相机对明确的高斯人进行光栅化.
因此,制成的图像相对于目标图像可以略微改变或扭曲.
这种变化很难看到,但受到像素度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度
LagerNVS显示的图案是相同的:有32个视图,其PSNR比ReSplate低0.48 dB,而其LPIPS为0.074对0.101.

blocks.en:
To test this, we refine the target pose on the target image as in the pose-free protocol ( Sec. B ), starting from the ground-truth pose ( Tab. S19 ).
Our router selects the tokens once from the ground-truth pose and the selection is held fixed, and ReSplat keeps its Gaussians and optimizes only the camera.
blocks.zh:
为了检验这一点,我们从地面真实的姿势(Tab.S19)开始,对目标图像进行精细化,如无姿势协议(Sec.B.)中那样。
我们的路由器从地面真实的姿势中选择过一次符号,并且选择被固定,ReSplat保留它的高斯人,并且只优化相机.

blocks.en:
Refinement raises the PSNR of our model by 0.6 to 1.9 dB, more with more source views, whereas that of ReSplat changes by + 0.06 +0.06 , − 0.02 -0.02 and − 0.17 -0.17 dB with 8, 16 and 32 views.
With refinement, our model is ahead of ReSplat in PSNR and LPIPS in all nine settings, in PSNR by 0.27 to 3.01 dB, and in SSIM in all but one ( B = 1369 B{=}1369 with 32 views).
The corrections are small: for our model, the median rotation is 0.04 to 0.10 degrees and the median translation is 0.6 to 2.0% of the median distance between consecutive source cameras.
That ReSplat gains at most 0.06 dB indicates that the target poses are consistent with the source poses, so the correction compensates for the misalignment of our renders.
blocks.zh:
改进后将我们的模型的PSNR提高了0.6至1.9 dB,更多的是来源视图,而ReSplating的改变则增加了+0.06+0.06,−0.02−0.02和−0.17-0.17 dB,有8,16和32的视图.
经过完善,我们的模型在所有9个设置中都领先于ReSplate的PSNR和LPIPS,在PSNR中比0.27比3.01 dB,在SSIM中除1外全部领先(B=1369 B{=}1369,有32个视图).
校正小:对我们的模型来说,中位旋转为0.04至0.10度,中位翻译为连续源相机间中位距离的0.6%至2.0%.
最高0.06分贝的ReSplate增益表明目标姿势与源头的姿势一致,因此校正弥补了我们制片的错配.
